audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer carried a blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows. Content win[N] and the packet levelChart both read Xerath / Xerath / Xerath / Xerath / Skill / Skill / Hwei, so four rows and the late row rendered a different answer from the chart beside them. phases[6].why also described Xerath winning late while win[6] says Hwei.
audit.why: Xerath Q is 750 and E 1050 and both charge from fog; Hwei's damage palette must be cast from inside that band, which is the early-lane edge. Late, Subject: Serenity (W) shields and Subject: Torment (E) zones an entire chokepoint, which is why the content layer, the packet and the 53.94% win rate all put the last row on Hwei.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 to Xerath (win[N] already Xerath). Row 6 to Hwei with phases[6].why rewritten in the same proposal to say why. Rows 4-5 left as Skill, which both layers already agree on.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late-game spike belonged to Hwei on the content layer but the full layer's phases[6].why and breakdown.late both claimed the late game for Xerath.
audit.why: Spiraling Despair is 120/100/80s at 1300 units and Subject: Serenity is a 16-18s shield palette — his teamfight output and his disengage both scale past a single-target barrage.
audit.corrected: phases[6].why and breakdown.late rewritten to name the scaling and the play pattern that answers it.
sources: brief.enemyKit R cd 120/100/80 range 1300, W cd 18/17.5/17/16.5/16 flags.shield

audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED ABILITY NAME. The full layer tracks 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' throughout — winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t and report[9].t. No such ability exists. Hwei's crowd-control palette is Subject: Torment (E), which paints Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw. The packet's own defect line flags that no real Hwei ability was ever named.
audit.why: The brief's enemy kit is Data Dragon authority: P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair.
audit.corrected: Every occurrence replaced with Subject: Torment (E) and its real sub-spells, plus the interaction that was never stated: Subject: Serenity shields through your burst window, so force it before you commit, and any of his hard CC ends Rite of the Arcane mid-channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit (lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); dontsFull[1].d called Shocking Orb a fourteen-second spell when it is 13s at rank 1.
audit.why: Subject: Torment is 12s at rank 1 and Subject: Serenity 18s — those two numbers decide when you may charge a Q in the open.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under unrelated titles (lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED); dontsFull[0].d was a name-swappable line.
audit.why: The bodies answered a different question from their titles, and the tradeBad line even referenced a dash Hwei does not have.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten from Hwei's palettes and cooldowns.

notes: The whole full layer tracked a fabricated ability, 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)', across ten fields — the packet's own defect line already said no real Hwei ability was ever named. Replaced with Subject: Torment (E) and its Data Dragon sub-spells. I did NOT carry over the content layer's sub-spell shorthand ('QE blind', 'WW fear', 'Spiral of Torment', 'EQ wall'): the kit gives the palette names but not which sub-spell blinds or fears, and the naming convention there does not match Riot's, so those content strings are left alone and flagged as unverified rather than guessed at. Chart: rows 0-3 needed a side edit only (win[N] already Xerath); rows 4-5 already agreed on Skill; row 6 moved to Hwei with its why rewritten in the same proposal to match win[6], which already read Hwei. Ratings left untouched throughout — the kit does not tell me whether the number describes the owner or the stage margin.
